scope: Uninstalled initialization interlock and bootstrap registry/exclusion-marker preparation; no RAM exclusion integration, activation, accounts/units, guest startup, reconciliation or hardware acceptance

initialization.limits: Only initializer side is wired. Portable RAM recovery must acquire same interlock and existing closed-runtime lease exclusion before target mutations; absent-runtime observation alone is insufficient.
